Kill 10 [[Hulking Stone Elemental]]s to prove yourself to [[Kendrick Redstaff]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = elementalist
}}

===Objectives===
*Kill ten [[Hulking Stone Elemental|hulking stone elementals]].
*0/10 hulking stone elementals slain.
*Return to Kendrick Redstaff.

===Reward===
*500 [[Experience]]
*100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
Leave [[Serenity Temple]] and walk around the [[Pockmark Flats]], killing any Hulking Stone Elementals you find. Large numbers of elementals can be found in the entrances to the [[Pockmark crystal|large crater]] to the east, and they can sometimes be found in the crater itself. Once you have killed 10, the quest is fullfilled and you can go for the reward. Alternatively, you can find large numbers of Hulking Stone Elementals in [[Old Ascalon]] without any [[Stone Elemental]] elementalists accompanying them.

Keep hold of any [[Scorched Lodestone]]s you find, since 3 will be needed for the following quest, [[The Geomancer's Test]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Kendrick Redstaff
:''"Ah. I can see you are not a complete fool. Most people hear my name and assume I specialize in fire magic. While I do know about all the elements, my specialty does indeed lie in channeling the power of the earth. If you would like to learn how to use earth magic then you must prove yourself worthy. Slay 10 of the '''hulking stone elementals''' that plague '''Pockmark Flats''' and then return to me. Do you have what it takes?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = An easy task.
| decline = Sounds tedious.
| ask = I thought I asked you to kill 10 '''hulking stone elementals'''. Why have you returned to me before accomplishing this task?
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Kendrick Redstaff
:''"Well, it's not like killing elementals is a trying task. I have no great faith that you learned anything useful from this bit of hunting, but I hope you at least had the sense to hold on the scorched lodestones you no doubt found."''

==Notes==
*Although Kendrick tells you to kill elementals in Pockmark Flats, the quest will update when you kill a Hulking Stone Elemental anywhere.
